Subject: Initial batch of onboarding docs + question on PO timing

Thanks for the warm welcome earlier this week. Per our call, I attached the initial vendor packet: certificate of insurance and our W-9. Please confirm receipt.

Spectra Supply Co.
elena.ruiz@spectrasupply.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectrasupply.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 17:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial batch of onboarding docs + question on PO timing

Elena —

Received, thanks for sending these over. I downloaded the COI and W-9 and started an intake ticket with Procurement (PR-4982). Two quick clarifications so we can avoid a follow-up:

1) Endorsements: we typically require Additional Insured on the GL for vendors that operate on our premises or integrate directly with our customer-facing systems. For vendors providing hosted software services we often accept the COI plus a written endorsement for Additional Insured. Can you confirm if your insurer can add:
   - "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors, employees and agents" as Additional Insured on the GL
2) Waiver of Subrogation: required when vendors process customer data in our environment. If Spectra is only providing physical goods (non-custodial) we can often accept without waiver; if you touch customer data or run services on our infra we will need a Waiver of Subrogation on the GL and Professional Liability.

3) PO timing: Procurement has two paths — conditional PO (issued once COI prima facie meets minimum limits with endorsement outstanding — used for urgent shipments) or full PO (issued after final endorsement). Conditional PO lead time is 2–4 business days from intake acceptance; full PO typically 7–10 business days. If Q4 cutoff is critical note that a conditional PO is possible.

Could you confirm whether Spectra is delivering hosted integration services or shipment-only goods? If hosted, please ask your broker for the Additional Insured endorsement and Waiver; if shipment-only, confirm and we can proceed on the conditional PO path while endorsement is routed.

Looping in Irene from Procurement to advise on PO issuance cadence.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Program Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectrasupply.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@spectrasupply.com
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial batch of onboarding docs + question on PO timing

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the clarity.

Spectra is shipment-first: we manufacture and ship hardware racks and have a small logistics integration (tracking/status API) but we do not host or store customer data. Our broker confirmed the insurer can issue the Additional Insured endorsement on the GL; Waiver of Subrogation will be declined by the insurer for our account due to policy language.

I attached the COI (same file) and PDF stub from our broker that shows they can add Additional Insured language. Attached W-9 as well. We'd like to request a conditional PO to meet our Q4 production schedule — can Procurement issue a conditional PO once you confirm minimum limits?

Attachments: Spectra_COI_2027-12-04.pdf (same), W-9_SpectraSupply_2027.pdf

Thanks,
Elena
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@spectrasupply.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2027 18:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial batch of onboarding docs + question on PO timing

Thanks Elena — appreciate the quick turnaround and the broker note.

Procurement has reviewed the packet and confirmed minimum limits are met on the COI for General Liability and Auto. Given Spectra's clarification that there is no customer data hosting, we will proceed with a conditional PO. Next steps: 

- We will issue a conditional PO (PO-4982-C) within 48 business hours. This PO will include a clause requiring finalized Additional Insured endorsement within 30 days of PO date.
- Please route endorsed COI to procurement@redwood.com and contracts@redwood.com.
- Our Finance onboarding team needs the invoice remit and bank wiring instructions prior to first payment — please send those as a separate attachment to procurement@redwood.com.

I attached a Redwood conditional PO template (PO-template-Redwood-conditional-stub.docx) with the clause language we will include — review and confirm acceptance so we can proceed.

If there are legal redlines to the clause, Contracts will follow up — CC'd is Logan from Contracts to manage any redlines.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
